Description: The performance baseline (D-007, npm run erp:perf-baseline) sends every journey as one user and does not suspend the rate limiter, which allows 1,800 reads a minute per account (src/server/platform/security/settings.js:14). After about 1,800 requests every response is 429 RATE_LIMITED: 8 of 9 journeys report 70-100 % errors, and their latencies measure the 429 answer. The stored baseline (docs/erp/perf/baseline.json, 2026-11-12) predates the limit.
Evidence: evidence/p8-perf-baseline.log; probe: 1,800 x 200 then 429 within one minute
Impact: The baseline cannot detect a performance regression; its comparison reports journeys 92-97 % faster because they are refused.
Recommendation: Suspend the limiter in the harness as scripts/dast_scan.mjs:23 does (or spread journeys over users) and store a new baseline after review.
